features.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
features.description: +2 STR, +2 WIS, -2 CHA

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium size; no inherent size adjustment.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with varg subtype.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 30-foot land speed.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Begin speaking Common and Lupin. High-INT optional languages: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin, Orc.

features.name: Fearless
features.description: +2 racial saving throws versus fear effects.

features.name: Natural Armor
features.description: +1 natural armor bonus.

features.name: Lycanthropy Resistance
features.description: Immune to lycanthropy curse; natural attacks count as silver to bypass DR; standard-action touch grants a lycanthrope insight bonus equal to half your level plus Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) on its check to return to human form.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: +2 racial Perception.

features.name: Wolf Empathy
features.description: +4 Handle Animal and Diplomacy dealing specifically with wolves, dire wolves, or wolf subtype creatures.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Primary bite natural weapon, 1d4; secondary while using manufactured weapons.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Darkvision 60 feet.

features.name: Scent
features.description: Scent ability.

features.name: Emotionless
features.description: -2 Diplomacy only when dealing with other races.

features.name: Cold Acclimated
features.description: Immune to normal environmental damage from cold below 40 F; below 0 F suffer normal cold, not extreme cold; Ice resistance 5.

features.name: Feral
features.description: Additional -2 Intelligence, while Perception and Stealth become class skills.

features.name: Heat Acclimated
features.description: Automatically succeed Fortitude saves to avoid heat dangers up to severe heat.

features.name: Influential
features.description: +2 Diplomacy.

features.name: Information Hunter
features.description: +2 Diplomacy gathering information only, and Knowledge (local) is a class skill.

features.name: Light Build
features.description: Replaces only the +2 STR adjustment with +2 DEX. Retains +2 WIS and -2 CHA.

features.name: Loper
features.description: +10 base speed from 30 to 40 feet and further +10 foot bonus for charge, run, and withdraw.

features.name: Midnight Child
features.description: Increase attack miss chance by 5 percentage points when you have concealment or total concealment.

features.name: Midnight Eyes
features.description: 120-foot darkvision replaces ordinary darkvision and Scent.

features.name: Savant
features.description: Replace racial ability score vector with +2 WIS, +2 CHA, -2 CON; +1 all saving throws.

features.name: Scavenger
features.description: +2 Appraise and Perception to find hidden objects, determine spoiled food, or identify potions by taste.

features.name: Gnoll Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 STR, +2 INT, -2 CHA

features.name: Gnoll Heritage Benefit
features.description: +4 Handle Animal and Diplomacy dealing with Hyenas instead of wolves. Hyena affinity instead of Wolf Empathy, alternative racial score vector.

features.name: Kitsune Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 CHA, -2 CON

features.name: Kitsune Heritage Benefit
features.description: +4 Handle Animal and Diplomacy dealing with Foxes instead of wolves. Fox affinity instead of Wolf Empathy, alternative racial score vector.
